caption.en-US: Blocking Home hides the For You feed and mutes it. The rest of TikTok stays reachable.
A blocked page shows a switch to bring it back. An unblocked page keeps a button in the corner to block it again.
Explore and LIVE are blocked and muted the same way.
The popup switches each page separately, and Ctrl+Shift+8 toggles the page you are on. Settings never leave your browser.
